*I worked on this activity with:* ______________________________

A traffic engineering study was conducted to investigate traffic delay at urban intersections. Three types of traffic signals were studied: pretimed, semi-actuated, and fully actuated. Fifteen intersections were completely randomly assigned to one of the three types of signals. The response variable was the average stopped time per vehicle (seconds) at each intersection.

The data for this study is provided in [`traffic_data.csv`](../_data/02_traffic_data.csv).

Download the data here or on Canvas and save it in your nicely organized "activities" or "data" folder!
